title: Silverwing Outpost
wikitext:
[[File:Silverwing Outpost.jpg|thumb|Silverwing Outpost]]
'''Silverwing Outpost''' is located in south-central [[Ashenvale]], north of the border with [[the Barrens]] and southwest of [[Splintertree Post]]. It is the eastern [[Alliance]] bastion of defense against the [[Horde]], and it is located on the Horde side of the [[Falfarren River]]. Because of this, the sentinels posted there have to fight back constant attacks from the nearby [[orc]]s, who are unrelenting in their goal of ridding the woods of the Silverwings once and for all.
